sources.title: EfficientFormer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Model transformer with an image classification head on top (a linear layer on top of the final hidden state of the [CLS] token) e.g. for ImageNet. This model is a PyTorch nn.Module subclass. Use it as a regular PyTorch Module and refer to the PyTorch documentation for all matter related to general usage and behavior.

sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone. EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset.
